newsitem.title: INDIA: India sets up panel to boost domestic savings.
newsitem.headline: India sets up panel to boost domestic savings.

text.p: India on Tuesday formed a panel which would recommend measures to improve domestic savings, a government statement said.
"The group will examine the existing tax provisions for household savings and suggest a plan of action to foster such savings in the immediate and medium term," the statement said.
The panel consisting of eminent economists is scheduled to submit its interim report by January 30 and its final report by April 30, 1997, the statement said.
It said India's current domestic savings are 24.4 percent of gross domestic product.
